nodeSelector.description: Node labels required for scheduling the uds-portal pod.

affinity.description: Affinity settings for the uds-portal pod (standard Kubernetes nodeAffinity, podAffinity, and podAntiAffinity).

tolerations.description: Tolerations for the uds-portal pod (standard Kubernetes toleration entries).

extraEnvs.description: Additional environment variables for the uds-portal container (standard Kubernetes EnvVar entries with value or valueFrom).

enabled.description: Enable or disable the classification banner.

addFooter.description: Indicates whether to add a footer to the classification banner.

text.description: The classification banner text must match one of the allowed values (case-insensitive): UNCLASSIFIED, CUI, CONFIDENTIAL, SECRET, TOP SECRET, TOP SECRET//SCI, UNKNOWN, or it can be an empty string or null.

enabled.description: Enable or disable the Admin Apps view in the portal.

extraVolumes.description: Additional volumes for the uds-portal pod (standard Kubernetes volume entries).

extraVolumeMounts.description: Additional volume mounts for the uds-portal container (standard Kubernetes volumeMount entries).
